This is the figure carried against the DC-B1 authorized ceiling; the journaled $0.0080 understated it by an async-lag artifact and must not be used for carry-forward accounting. Per-claim this is $0.0301, above the clean single-adjudication pack-reuse band (costs.PACK_REUSE_USD_MEASURED 0.0036-0.0132) precisely because of 0462's triple call, so it stays an OUTLIER outside that band rather than widening it.
